# THOR CAPABILITY MATRIX — exhaustive per-feature probe (2026-08-06)
#
# Generated by scripts/cap_probe.sh. Written after LOOP_LOG Findings 29 and 30, where a capability
# was declared absent TWICE because the probe covered only one instruction family.
#
# HEADLINE: Thor (sm_110a) is SM100-class DATACENTER Blackwell minus wgmma.
#   AVAILABLE and UNUSED by our engine:
#     tcgen05  — every kind, including mxf4nvf4 (FP4 block-scaled) and mxf8f6f4; ld/st/cp/shift;
#                cta_group::2. This is the DeepGEMM/CUTLASS-SM100 family.
#     TMA      — cp.async.bulk, tensor.tile 2D/3D, multicast, store, reduce, prefetch.tensormap
#     cluster  — barrier.cluster, mapa (DSMEM), %cluster_ctarank
#     async    — mbarrier (+try_wait), setmaxnreg, elect.sync, griddepcontrol (= PDL)
#     staging  — ldmatrix (incl. .m16n16.b8 -> LDSM.8.MT1616), stmatrix
#     cache    — createpolicy L2, ld.L1::no_allocate, prefetch.global.L2 (CCTL.E.PF2),
#                discard.global.L2 (CCTL.E.RML2), cp.async .L2::cache_hint
#     fp6      — cvt e3m2 / e2m3
#     int      — mma.sync s8 and s4, dp4a, redux, lop3, prmt
#   BLOCKED on Thor:
#     mma.sync with FP4/FP6 operands, and mma.sync .kind::mxf4 block-scale
#         -> but tcgen05 provides exactly this capability, so FP4 matmul IS available
#     wgmma (entire Hopper-lineage family)
#
# What our engine currently uses out of all of the above:
#     mma.sync HMMA (f16 / e4m3), cp.async.cg, lop3/prmt, __nv_cvt_fp4x2_to_halfraw2.
#     Everything else on the AVAILABLE list is unexploited.
#
# NOTE: rows marked "probe-err" are syntax errors in the probe, NOT capability rejections.
#       Do not read them as BLOCKED.
#
